content.text:
"Revenue" could mean three different governed metrics, all certified, so I want to make sure I pull the right one:

1. **Gross merchandise value (GMV)**: everything buyers paid on paid orders, before refunds, in EUR.
2. **Net merchandise value**: what buyers paid on paid orders, after refunds, in EUR.
3. **Commission revenue**: the commission the marketplace charged dealers on paid orders, minus commission refunded to dealers, in EUR. This is what the marketplace itself earned.

Which one do you need? If you're asking about the marketplace's own earnings, commission revenue is the usual choice. I'll pull last quarter's figure once you confirm.
